as_told.title: Bell destroyed plants and killed the first team of scientists

plain: The story goes that in the 1940s Nazi Germany secretly built a strange device called the Bell, somewhere in Germany or Czechoslovakia, and that it was deadly to the people who worked on it. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells it from the British journalist Nick Cook's book The Hunt for Zero Point. Dolan says the claim is that a group of around 60 scientists was involved, that many of them died from the effects of the device, and that the rest were executed at the end of the war so they could not talk. The researcher Jason Jorjani, in an episode about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO program, describes something else about the device. He says plants placed around the Bell would turn to mulch, and he speaks of a "first team" of workers. Jorjani does not give the figure of 60 or say that the survivors were killed. The tellers raise it because it suggests the Nazis had a power far beyond the science of their day.
